summary: Race your best run: the player's path is sampled on game time while a time trial runs, the fastest run per trial (and per TrialRun.variant, e.g. a lap count) is kept on the device, and a ghost placed in the scene replays it on the next attempt.
setup: List GhostKeeper in Game(systems=[...]) (from game.lib.ghost_racer import GhostKeeper).
Add { "use": "ghost_recorder" } to the player prefab, and place a ghost (any look, with { "use": "ghost_playback" }, no collider) in each timed scene.
